en.title: The Pulse of Brass and the Frozen Heart
en.premise: The great climate control system that once warmed the world malfunctioned, transforming into a monolithic fortress of ice. Armed with a fractured thermal blade, a seasoned mechanic descends into the frozen mechanical core to reclaim the world's lost heat. Amidst the grinding of brass gears and the roar of steam, he begins a perilous mission to salvage the remnants of civilization.

zh.title: 真鍮的鼓动与零下的心脏
zh.premise: 曾经温暖世界的巨大气候控制装置在暴走后，如今已化作一座巍峨的冰之城。为了夺回这个停滞世界的温度，一名经验丰富的修理工手持破损的热切断剑，潜入那颗被冻结的机械心脏。在黄铜齿轮的摩擦之声与蒸汽的咆哮之中，他开始了这场为了挽救文明遗产而赌上性命的修理之旅。
